Trusted local serial capability channel, four loaded roles, WorkOrder/WorkResult responsibility and adoption, atomic execution takeover and presentation gate. Real models and external chat interception unbound.

host_binding.target_host: Python local serial NetworkHost; synthetic workspace
host_binding.skill_discovery_and_routing: Loads four role specifications and role-specific Skill source files; not installed
host_binding.tool_bindings: Opaque in-process capability; fixed B5 professional operations and controlled store calls
host_binding.delegation_and_receipts: Explicit synchronous WorkOrder acceptance and WorkResult return/adoption
host_binding.single_user_facing_executor_enforcement: Current AG0 capability + stored execution epoch within NetworkHost channel
host_binding.serial_commit_enforcement: Existing SQLite transactions; OS lock permits one NetworkHost per workspace
host_binding.record_directory: Caller explicitly chooses a synthetic workspace outside suite resources
host_binding.deletion_and_host_history_capability: Managed SQLite dependency cleanup and affected capability revocation; external history/context uncontrolled
host_binding.cost_wait_and_budget_limits: Existing shared BudgetEnvelope reference; no duplicate budget or new accounting queue
host_binding.note: Trusted local process boundary; direct legacy scripts and external model/chat/filesystem paths are outside host gate. Real course/model and V1—V4 remain B7.
